recommendedProfile.limits: Measured fresh submissions, not locked 60 FPS or physical scanout/audio qualification; requested 120 FPS/40 Mbps remains unstable.

originalCrash.scope: User identified D-pad/stick navigation. Baseline and repaired terminate/navigation loops inject controller-equivalent events and are bounded checks, not physical-controller qualification or proof of the original crash cause.

workload: Sequential live Sunshine runs with native trackpad motion and overlay enabled. Baseline used Virtual Display; the first badge-only run used Desktop after the termination check. Compare host application and content before attributing all FPS differences to code. User confirmed moving content before the guarded Virtual Display check.
measurement: Fresh native video submissions, not optical scanout or input-to-display latency. Native badge registers/pixel samples show the overlay was enabled; no full UI redraw is required per stats update.
